title.narrative: Protection of Vulnerable Migrants in Central Asia

description.narrative: Protection of Vulnerable Migrants with Special Emphasis on Empowering Women in the Context of Migration in Central Asia. Regional project for Central Asia is a continuation of current IOM interventions on counter-trafficking and protecting vulnerable migrants and communities. The proposed project aims to contribute to the protection of migrants and increase the resilience of vulnerable migrants, especially women, in Central Asia, in the context of the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic.
